label: Belancer
terms_note: Belancer publishes its own OpenAPI (/api/openapi.json) but no developer programme, and its terms page could not be read (JS-only, 2026-09-05). Search, details and messages run on the user's own login through that API; bid submission stays closed until Belancer's written permission is recorded (config.permission_confirmed). Registering an account in a browser session is automation the venue has not licensed — you opt in per account.

discovery.auth: oauth2 password flow (POST /token → bearer; refresh via /auth/token/refresh)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (full seller surface in the site's OpenAPI). Lane `assist` → **api (partial)** once Belancer confirms third-party use. Confidence high (openapi.json opened).
reference.limits: - Terms not readable (JS); no rate limit documented in the spec; credits / bid fees not read.

fields.name: username
fields.help: E-mail address of your Belancer account (POST /auth/login validates username as an e-mail).

fields.name: password
fields.help: Password of the same Belancer account.

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is published in the OpenAPI document. One request per second.
adapter.terms: Belancer publishes its OpenAPI (/api/openapi.json) but no developer programme; its terms page could not be read (JS-only). Runs on your own login.

search_postings.note: GET /projects/search ('Search Projects'): query, category_id (integer), min_budget, page (default 1), limit (default 10), status=open fixed. The OpenAPI gives no response schema; the live response (2026-09-24) is {total, page, limit, projects[]} with id, name, description, currency, min_budget, max_budget, posted_by, created_at — mapped from that. skills[] item shape is undocumented (raw).

get_posting.note: GET /projects/{project_id} ('Get Project'; integer id); same record shape as a search hit (live response 2026-09-24).

not_offered.submit_bid: POST /projects/{project_id}/bids exists in the OpenAPI, but bid submission stays closed until Belancer's written permission for third-party bidding is recorded (terms unreadable; no developer programme).
not_offered.bid_status: Bid endpoints are kept closed together with submit_bid until Belancer permits third-party use.
not_offered.list_messages: Project messages are addressed by two ids (GET /messages/project/{project_id}/{receiver_id}); the vocabulary's thread_id cannot carry both.
not_offered.send_message: Sending needs project_id and receiver_id (POST /messages/project/{project_id}/{receiver_id}); the vocabulary's thread_id cannot carry both.
not_offered.credits: Bid credits (bid_credit_cost per project) have no balance endpoint in the OpenAPI.

evidence: host belancer.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
spec https://belancer.com/api/openapi.json: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
live read without credentials: get_posting, search_postings returned data that validates against the vocabulary
